# Let me read more around this area to find what other edits were made
chunk = await CONTEXT.read(85000, 9000)  # Read a broader section
# Find all tool entries
import re
matches = list(re.finditer(r'(\[tool \d+\])', chunk))
for m in matches:
    start = m.start()
    # Get the line
    line_end = chunk.find('\n', start)
    if line_end == -1:
        line_end = start + 200
    print(f"offset={start}: {chunk[start:line_end]}")
